name: model-migration
description: Migrate an app's code, config and prompts to a newer model generation for any provider: inventory model ids, update ids and parameters (effort, thinking budget, limits, retired fields), tune prompts for more literal models, compare before and after.

steps.step: run the whole migration as one guided command
inventory model ids and parameters, pick targets, record a baseline
update ids and parameters, re-run the baseline and compare
tune prompts only for the regressions observed
